criteria.description: Elaborate 4-pillar wedding Mandap with gold pillars, royal canopy arches, and draped fabric.
criteria.visual_observations: Four fluted gold pillars with ornate capitals, scalloped Mughal arch, draped silk curtains, marigold torans, and hanging brass temple bells are vividly rendered.

criteria.description: Bride & Groom in traditional royal Indian wedding attire with clear silhouettes and detailed ornaments.
criteria.visual_observations: Bride and groom feature distinct royal Indian bridal attire: red zardozi lehenga, sheer veil, chooda bangles, maang tikka, ivory sherwani with safa, kalgi, necklaces, and gathbandhan knot.

criteria.description: Sacred Hawan/Agni Kund fire pit placed between the couple with radiant fire glow.
criteria.visual_observations: The stepped copper Hawan Kund features burning logs, multi-layered glowing flames with bloom filters, rising embers, and warm radiant lighting.

criteria.description: Rich festive Indian wedding ambiance including rangoli, glowing diyas, marigold torans, and celestial night sky.
criteria.visual_observations: Rich ambiance with symmetrical lotus rangoli, six glowing clay diyas, scattered petals, fairy lights, luminous moon, and starry dusk sky.

criteria.description: Celebratory wedding banner text 'SHUBH VIVAH' with elegant typography and ornamental symbols.
criteria.visual_observations: Golden serif 'SHUBH VIVAH' title with traditional paisley motifs and elegant subtitle is centered and balanced.
